assertions.text: The policy states: When a visit and a minor procedure are billed for the same day by the same provider, the visit is paid only if modifier 25 is on the visit code and the record supports a significant evaluation that is separate from the procedure.

citations.quote: When a visit and a minor procedure are billed for the same day by the same provider, the visit is paid only if modifier 25 is on the visit code and the record supports a significant evaluation that is separate from the procedure.

assertions.text: The policy states: The record must describe the evaluation separately from the procedure.

citations.quote: The record must describe the evaluation separately from the procedure.

assertions.text: The record states: Diabetes review: fasting glucose readings 180 to 220 over the past three weeks; increased thirst.

citations.quote: Diabetes review: fasting glucose readings 180 to 220 over the past three weeks; increased thirst.

assertions.text: The record states: Examination: feet checked, sensation intact, pulses present; weight up 2 kg since last visit.

citations.quote: Examination: feet checked, sensation intact, pulses present; weight up 2 kg since last visit.
